title: Beta photoelectron yield below or near the dark-limited threshold
trigger_or_cause: Assumed beta signal 4 to 120 p.e. (typical 15, no measurement) against a dark-limited BETA_LLD of about 7 to 8 p.e. at -20 C, 8 to 9 at +10 C, 10 to 11 at +25 C for one 6 mm device (calculated); yield unknown by a factor of 30.
consequence: Beta channel unusable or insensitive; the head may not work at all (head_afe_budget.md section 3.2: principal risk).
proposed_control: RFQ asks for a guaranteed and tested p.e. yield (RFQ 0.4); choose low-crosstalk SiPM, low overvoltage, +10 C set-point, short resolving time; measure with Sr-90/Y-90 or Tl-204.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Measured p.e. spectrum and dark-trigger scans on a real lane (VT-042) with a stated margin.
current_mitigation_0_4: RFQ addition only; no supplier data; board provides shaping, overvoltage and temperature choices.

title: A single pass does not reach 0.20 Bq/cm2
trigger_or_cause: At assumed K = 24 per second per Bq/cm2 and about four background counts per second, D# is 0.408 (uncompensated, uniform field) and 0.510 (compensated, matched reference) at 0.1 uSv/h for a 1 s pass; K itself depends on the undefined measurand.
consequence: The moving-sensitivity target RQ-022 is not met in one pass; false-flag allowance at the mission level raises D# further (0.902 at alpha 1.14e-5).
proposed_control: Survey methods of DEC-038 (search then count, step and count, continuous scan at about 0.025 m/s); more sensitive reference tile or pooled references; site to define K basis, patch size and alpha.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Measured K and background on the head (K_beta measurement, report section 8) and a site decision on patch size and probabilities.
current_mitigation_0_4: Calculated only; mission-time estimates for the three methods in the architecture document.

title: Alpha channel not viable for scanning at 10 mm standoff
trigger_or_cause: 0.20 Bq/cm2 gives about 1.20 counts per second in the alpha channel (assumed K_alpha = 6), below the three counts needed for 95 % detection with zero background; response changes by tens of per cent for 2 mm of gap or a 35 K change of air temperature.
consequence: Alpha results cannot be produced while moving; stationary alpha needs controlled standoff.
proposed_control: Report alpha only from stationary dwell of at least 10 s with a measured standoff (RQ-066).
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Alpha response versus standoff and temperature (VT-044).
current_mitigation_0_4: Calculated range model; no measurement.

trigger_or_cause: The fault table lists dangerous faults not detected at standstill: open brake path or brake resistor (row 46), head-loop comparator or its driver failing healthy (rows 18, 23), welded K1 contacts (rows 39, 40), chain wire short to +12 V (rows 8, 31), selector RUN contact welded (row 3), watchdog dead between boots (rows 34, 36), bumper switch failed closed between checks (row 28), head-internal bypass of rail switches (row 24).
consequence: Loss of the stop function for one wheel or one element without indication; stopping distance up to 55 mm (one motor braked) or 56 mm (MCU fails with torque).
proposed_control: Decide which faults get a second channel (diverse loop evaluation, force-guided relays with mirror contacts, 25 mm height) or a periodic dynamic brake check (RQ-057, RQ-058); pre-use actuation of each contact element.
residual_risk_evidence_needed: Written hazard-owner disposition of every undetected fault; dynamic brake check results (VT-045).
current_mitigation_0_4: Firmware cross-checks (ADC against comparators, CHAIN_END_RB, boot test of watchdog and permit) and the stationary brake test; the chain is stated not to be a certified safety function.
